02 / 14

Three minutes.
Three reasoning criteria.

The M2 usability hypothesis: one headline and supporting context help a new peer choose and explain a next investigation, unaided.

  1. Name an investigation. Choose a specific next question.
  2. Connect the evidence. Use the headline and at least one related signal.
  3. Identify uncertainty. State what remains unknown.

Stop rule: if any criterion fails, revise and retest before adding features. No coaching or spreadsheet export.

Evidence: Locked hypothesis and stop rule

The Validation: a lower total
can hide steady channel rates

Illustrative sample · completed seven-day activation cohorts
SignalPrevious 4 weeksLast 4 weeks
Overall activation336 / 800 42%304 / 800 38%
Direct & organic240 / 480 50%160 / 320 50%
Paid acquisition96 / 320 30%144 / 480 30%
Paid share of signups320 / 800 40%480 / 800 60%

The arithmetic supports an investigation. It does not establish why the audience mix changed.

The usability claim remains open. Qualitative feedback exposed M2 answer cues, corrected in M3. A fresh unaided human study has not run. Feedback is not a representative study.

07 / 14

The Logic: make each prompt
produce the next step’s input

  1. ExpandSequential Logic

    Build comparison and detail from one fixture.
    Search: 80/200 → 96/240.
    Social: 16/120 → 48/240.

  2. BehaviorConstraint Grounding

    Preserve exact totals and periods. Add loading, empty, error and Retry. A real 404 recovered to 200.

  3. RefineReflection Prompt

    Audit only the heading against the reference. It already matched.
    Verified outcome: no change.

These are development prompts. No model runs inside the dashboard.

Evidence: Expand → Behavior → Refine and results · Runtime boundary

12 / 14

One signal. One fix.
A redeployed saved summary.

Signal: public v7 review found no copy action. Demand remains unmeasured.

Fix: v8 adds Copy summary.

Guardrail: if saved, export saved content only. Exclude drafts and account metadata. Show Copied only after clipboard success. On failure, offer manual copying.

158 tests passed. Public guest and local private copying checked. Fallback has automated coverage only.

Evidence: Signal, chosen fix and prompt · Redeploy and checks · Actual copied output
13 / 14

Iterate.
Test reasoning before adding more.

I built a working investigation prototype for public guests and confirmed accounts. I learned that evidence and a saved answer do not establish independent understanding.

Next, I will test fresh representative product leads against all three M2 criteria, unaided. If any fails, revise and retest before adding features. Evaluate the copied summary’s usefulness separately.
